text: The property lost 25.5 ha of tree cover in 2015 due to a supported tree-cover loss event. This event is documented in the Hansen Global Forest Change data (GFC-2025-v1.13), which tracks stand-replacing tree-cover loss at a 30m resolution annually from 2001 to 2025. The event is corroborated by the data, indicating a significant loss of tree cover in that year. The loss is part of the property's history before the baseline period of 2021-2025, during which no further tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or more were detected.
